primary.title: Reliance Industries announces 49th AGM date, sets record date for FY26 dividend
primary.summary: Reliance Industries' 49th AGM will be held on 19 June 2026. The record date for dividend eligibility is 5 June. The company reported a 12.9% increase in Q1 revenue and a 16% rise in net profit for FY26.
